```json
 "topology": "StrongARM latch + output inverters",
 "rationale": "A single-stage StrongARM has no static current, so energy is only switched charge: about 60-80 fF of internal and output capacitance at VDD^2 = 3.24 V^2 gives roughly 0.25 pJ. A minimum-L input pair and latch give large gm/C, so regeneration time constants are about 10 ps. With an input-pair gain of about 5, ln(0.9/0.01) ≈ 4.5 time constants plus the inverter delay stays below 150 ps. PMOS resets precharge all four internal nodes, so the outputs are equal during reset."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "W_tail":  (6.0, 2.0, 16.0),   # clocked tail NMOS width [um]
    "W_in":    (6.0, 2.0, 16.0),   # input pair width [um]
    "W_nl":    (2.0, 0.6, 6.0),    # latch NMOS width [um]
    "W_pl":    (3.0, 0.8, 8.0),    # latch PMOS width [um]
    "W_rst":   (1.0, 0.42, 3.0),   # reset PMOS width [um]
    "W_invn":  (1.0, 0.42, 4.0),   # output inverter NMOS width [um]
    "L":       (0.15, 0.15, 0.3),  # channel length of core devices [um]
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    dv   = spec.get("dv", 0.002)
    fclk = spec.get("fclk", 500e6)
    cl   = spec.get("cl", 10e-15)
    vdd  = 1.8
    vcm  = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    L    = p["L"]
    Wt, Wi, Wnl, Wpl, Wr, Wn = (p["W_tail"], p["W_in"], p["W_nl"],
                                p["W_pl"], p["W_rst"], p["W_invn"])
    Wp_inv = 2.5 * Wn

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn clk outp outn vdd vss")
    # tail switch
    n.M("Mt",  "tail", "clk", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wt, L)
    # input pair: vinp side -> node xp / latch node op_i
    n.M("M1",  "xp", "vinp", "tail", "vss", "nfet", Wi, L)
    n.M("M2",  "xn", "vinn", "tail", "vss", "nfet", Wi, L)
    # cross-coupled NMOS: an (vinp side, goes low when vinp>vinn), bn
    n.M("M3",  "an", "bn", "xp", "vss", "nfet", Wnl, L)
    n.M("M4",  "bn", "an", "xn", "vss", "nfet", Wnl, L)
    # cross-coupled PMOS
    n.M("M5",  "an", "bn", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wpl, L)
    n.M("M6",  "bn", "an", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wpl, L)
    # reset switches (clk low -> precharge to VDD)
    n.M("Mr1", "an", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wr, 0.15)
    n.M("Mr2", "bn", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wr, 0.15)
    n.M("Mr3", "xp", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wr, 0.15)
    n.M("Mr4", "xn", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wr, 0.15)
    # output inverters: outp = NOT(an) -> high when vinp>vinn; reset -> both 0
    n.M("Mip", "outp", "an", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp_inv, 0.15)
    n.M("Min", "outp", "an", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wn, 0.15)
    n.M("Mjp", "outn", "bn", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp_inv, 0.15)
    n.M("Mjn", "outn", "bn", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wn, 0.15)

    # ---------- first-order predictions ----------
    cox_w = 1.0e-15                     # ~ gate/junction cap per um at L=0.15
    c_x   = (Wi + Wnl) * 0.6e-15 + Wr * 0.6e-15
    c_a   = (Wnl + Wpl) * (0.6e-15 + cox_w) + Wr * 0.6e-15 + (Wn + Wp_inv) * cox_w
    # integration phase: tail current discharging xp/xn
    op_in = lut.op('n', Wi, L, vcm - 0.15, 0.6)
    gm_in, id_in = op_in["gm"], max(op_in["Id"], 1e-6)
    t_int = (c_x + c_a) * 0.6 / id_in           # time to bring the latch on (~Vth drop)
    av = gm_in * t_int / max(c_x + c_a, 1e-16)
    av = min(max(av, 1.0), 10.0)
    # regeneration
    gm_n = lut.op('n', Wnl, L, 0.9, 0.9)["gm"]
    gm_p = lut.op('p', Wpl, L, 0.9, 0.9)["gm"]
    tau  = c_a / max(gm_n + gm_p, 1e-6)
    t_reg = tau * math.log(vdd / 2 / max(av * dv, 1e-6))
    t_inv = 0.69 * (cl + 2e-15) / max(lut.op('p', Wp_inv, 0.15, 1.8, 0.9)["gm"] * 0.5, 1e-6) * 0.5
    delay = t_int + t_reg + t_inv

    c_sw   = 2 * c_x + 2 * c_a + cl + (Wn + Wp_inv) * cox_w + Wt * 0.6e-15
    energy = c_sw * vdd ** 2

    return n, {"correct": 1, "delay": delay, "energy": energy}
```
